messages:
Maria CS: FYI — Silverpine renewal conversation. Customer needs a 9‑month term extension, +15 seats prorated for 30 days, and to change invoicing to their EU entity (Silverpine EU LTD). They also insist on a wet (ink) signature for the amendment due to local counsel. Can we accept a scanned wet-signed page and still process?

Aj Sales: We can probably do the 9mo extension. Pricing ask is odd — they want the current rate capped and a one-time 10% seat discount on the add-on. Need legal signoff on scanned wet signature and accounting signoff on Net45 payment terms. @Kevin Legal can you confirm? :thinking:

Kevin Legal: Scanned wet signatures are usually workable if the amendment wording is clear and we keep an audit trail. I need to review the amendment language (signature block + acceptance clause) and confirm no special notarization required. Also ask them about tax withholding clauses for EU entity. Send draft to me.

Sophie Account: Billing needs the new legal entity name, registered address, and VAT/tax id before we can reissue invoices. If they're switching entity we need a new PO referencing the new entity. Net45 is fine but we'll need credit team OK for extended terms.

Maria CS: They said their legal can wet sign and scan back a PDF, and they can courier the original if needed. They also asked whether we can accept the scanned page bundled with an email attestation from their GC. I will capture that as next step.

Aj Sales: I'll tell the AE to push for the scanned PDF + email attestation, and to get the VAT/tax id. We'll offer the 10% one-time seat discount on the add-on if legal approves scanned signature and finance ok with Net45.

Kevin Legal: Draft amendment checklist for me: 1) explicit signature page with printed name, title, and date; 2) clause allowing scanned copy as evidence; 3) tax/withholding paragraph for EU entity; 4) confirm export control/materials clause remains intact. Put the amendment in tracked changes and send.

Sophie Account: Creating the billing ticket now. Please provide the exact invoice header info in this format so we can map it:

```
BillingEntity: Silverpine EU LTD
Address: Rua das Flores 21, 3rd Floor, Lisbon, PT-1200
VAT: PT123456789
Currency: EUR
PaymentTerm: Net45
```

Sophie Account: Also linking to the ticket will require a PO scan with matching entity name. If they want proration for the 15 seats for 30 days, state the proration period start/end and we'll compute a credit/invoice.

Maria CS: AE will gather VAT + courier ETA and send the draft amendment to @Kevin Legal by EOD. Customer asked for a one‑pager instructions doc on how to wet sign and return — can someone draft a short checklist? :white_check_mark:

Iris Ops Bot: Reminder — create renewal task in CRM (account: Silverpine) and tag @Sophie Account, @Maria CS, @Aj Sales. Task ID: CR-89321.

Aj Sales: I'll draft the 1‑pager checklist and paste it in this thread for review. Quick draft: 1) Print amendment; 2) Sign full signature block with ink; 3) Scan at 300dpi and email to renewals@redwood.ai with subject "Silverpine — Wet Signed Amendment"; 4) Mail original to Redwood Legal (address will be provided if required).

Kevin Legal: That checklist is fine. Add line: include scanned copy of signer's government ID if our compliance team requests it (sensitivity vary by region).

Maria CS: Great. Next steps: AE to collect VAT/tax id + PO, send draft amendment to Kevin, Billing to await entity details and PO, Legal to review for scanned signature acceptance. I'll follow up tomorrow morning.
